children: reported a 8.4% rise in half-year headline earnings on Thursday, supported by revenue growth on increased client activity and as it expanded its average lending book.

Investec posted headline earnings per share of 39.8 pence for the six months ended September 30, compared with 36.7 pence in the previous year. It announced an interim dividend of 18.5 pence per share.
